title: SDCD: Structure-Disrupted Contrastive Decoding for Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measured by comparing model generation behaviors and logit distributions between original image views and structure-disrupted (patch-shuffled) views, and evaluating object hallucination reduction on benchmarks like POPE, MME, and CHAIR.

Evaluated using the POPE benchmark across its Random, Popular, and Adversarial sampling settings to systematically quantify hallucinations induced by frequent-object bias and object co-occurrence bias.
